exercises.instructionEn: Use the phrases in the list to complete the dialogues below: I don't - Nor do I - I do - So do I.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan quyidagi dialoglarni to'ldiring: I don't - Nor do I - I do - So do I.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROZILIK / NOROZILIK (coursebook
  15-bet 'So - Neither/Nor').

  ROZILIK (men ham):
    tasdiqqa: SO do I
      'I always do my homework.' -
      'So do I.' = Men ham.
    inkorga: NOR do I / Neither do I
      'I never watch TV.' - 'Nor do
      I.' = Men ham (ko'rmayman).

  NOROZILIK (men esa yo'q/ha):
    tasdiqqa: I DON'T
      'I often go to the cinema.' -
      'I don't.' = Men esa bormayman.
    inkorga: I DO
      'I never tidy my room.' -
      'I do.' = Men esa yig'ishtiraman.


⚠ 'NEVER' = INKOR:

  'I never ...' inkor gap →
  rozilik 'Nor do I', norozilik
  'I do'.


⚠ KALIT - KEYINGI GAP:

  1 'it doesn't take a long time' →
    yig'ishtiradi → I DO (norozi)
  4 'I hate going to the cinema' →
    bormaydi → I DON'T (norozi)
  2, 3 - davomi yo'q → rozilik:
    So do I / Nor do I.


⚠ 'TO TIDY':

  = yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga
  keltirmoq.


⚠ 'IT DOESN'T TAKE A LONG TIME':

  = ko'p vaqt olmaydi. 'take' =
  (vaqt) olmoq.

lines.speaker: 3 A
lines.en: I never watch TV in my free time.
lines.uz: Men bo'sh vaqtimda hech qachon televizor ko'rmayman.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz: ⚠ ROZILIK inkorga → 'Nor do I' (= Neither do I).

lines.speaker: 4 A
lines.en: I often go to the cinema at weekends.
lines.uz: Men dam olish kunlari tez-tez kinoga boraman.

lines.speaker: B

lines.uz: Men esa bormayman. Kinoga borishni yomon ko'raman.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ NOROZILIK tasdiqqa → 'I don't'. Davomi: 'kinoni yomon ko'raman'.

exercises.instructionEn: 8 Rutherford Drive, Toronto, Canada. 6th May, ... Dear Laura, ... Best wishes, Sally
exercises.instructionUz: 8 Rutherford Drive, Toronto, Kanada. 6-may, ... Aziz Lora, ... Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Salli
exercises.explanationUz:
QALAMKASh DO'STGA XAT - SALLY
  SHELBY (13 yosh, Toronto).
  (coursebook 15-bet Project - Steve
  xati bilan bir xil qolip)

TUZILISh (4 xatboshi):
  1 Ism, shahar, yosh, TAShQI
    QIYOFA
  2 OILA (a'zolari, kasblari,
    xarakteri)
  3 YOQTIRGAN NARSALAR (bo'sh
    vaqt, sevimli ...)
  4 XULOSA (that's all about me,
    write back soon)


⚠ 'THERE ARE FOUR OF US':

  = Biz to'rt kishimiz. 'four of
  us' - 'we are four' EMAS!


⚠ 'AGED FOURTEEN':

  = o'n to'rt yoshli. 'aged' + son.


⚠ 'A BIT BOSSY':

  'bossy' = buyruqboz (boshqalarga
  buyruq berishni yoqtiradigan).
  'a bit' = biroz - yumshatadi.
  'can be ... sometimes' = ba'zan
  ... bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ 'THE LOCAL LIBRARY':

  'local' = mahalliy; 'a library' =
  kutubxona (do'kon EMAS -
  'bookshop').


⚠ SHAQUILLE O'NEAL:

  = mashhur amerikalik basketbolchi
  (NBA, 2,16 m).
  MARIAH CAREY = amerikalik
  qo'shiqchi.


⚠ 'THAT'S ALL ABOUT ME':

  = Men haqimda shu. Xat xulosasi.


⚠ 'WRITE BACK SOON':

  = tez orada javob yoz.
  'to write back' = javob yozmoq.


⚠ KANADA MANZILI:

  8 Rutherford Drive = Rutherford
  ko'chasi, 8-uy. 'Drive' = ko'cha
  turi (Road, Street, Drive, Avenue).

points.noteUz:
⚠ Manzil yuqori o'ng burchakda, keyin sana.
⚠ 'Drive' - ko'cha turi.

points.en: My name is Sally Shelby and I live in Toronto, Canada. I am thirteen years old and I am tall and slim with green eyes and long straight brown hair.
points.uz: Mening ismim Salli Shelbi va men Torontoda, Kanadada yashayman. Men o'n uch yoshdaman va baland bo'yli, nozikman, yashil ko'zli va uzun tekis jigarrang sochliman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 1 - ism, shahar, yosh, tashqi qiyofa.
⚠ 'tall and slim WITH green eyes' - 'with' + belgi.

points.en: There are four of us in our family; my parents Nick and Heather, my sister Susan, aged fourteen, and me. My father is a policeman and my mother works at the local library. They're kind people and very generous. My sister is kind too, but she can be a bit bossy sometimes.
points.uz: Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz: ota-onam Nik va Xezer, o'n to'rt yoshli opam Syuzan va men. Otam politsiyachi, onam mahalliy kutubxonada ishlaydi. Ular mehribon va juda saxiy odamlar. Opam ham mehribon, lekin ba'zan biroz buyruqboz bo'lishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 - oila.
⚠ 'There are four of us' = biz to'rt kishimiz.
⚠ 'aged fourteen' = 14 yoshli.
⚠ 'a bit bossy' = biroz buyruqboz.

points.en: In my free time, I love playing basketball and listening to music. My favourite basketball player is Shaquille O'Neal and my favourite singer is Mariah Carey. I also like going to the cinema and visiting my friends at weekends.
points.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda basketbol o'ynash va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman. Sevimli basketbolchim - Shakil O'Nil, sevimli qo'shiqchim - Maraya Keri. Dam olish kunlari kinoga borish va do'stlarimnikiga borishni ham yoqtiraman.

points.en: Well, that's all about me. I hope you like the pictures of my family. Write back soon and please send me a picture of your family.
points.uz: Xo'sh, men haqimda shu. Oilamning suratlari senga yoqadi deb umid qilaman. Tez orada javob yoz va iltimos, oilangning suratini yubor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 4 - xulosa.
⚠ 'Write back soon' = tez orada javob yoz.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false), then look at the picture and say what Sally and her family look like.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang, so'ng suratga qarab Salli va uning oilasi qanday ko'rinishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
T/F - XATGA QARAB.

  1 Toronto - KANADA (Avstraliya
    EMAS) → F
  2 'tall and slim' (short EMAS) → F
  3 Opasi SUSAN; Heather - ONASI → F
  4 'I love playing basketball' → T
  5 'I also like going to the
    cinema' (hate EMAS) → F


SURATLAR - OILA QIYOFASI:

  1-surat: ona (Heather) - sariq
    kalta soch, va qiz - sariq
    uzun soch, tabassum
  2-surat: ota (Nick) - qora kalta
    soch, ko'k ko'ylak, va qiz -
    uzun qora soch

  Namuna: 'Sally's mother has got
  short fair hair. Her father has
  got short dark hair. Sally is
  tall and slim with long straight
  brown hair.'

items.whyUz: ⚠ F. Toronto - KANADADA: 'I live in Toronto, Canada.'
⚠ F. Heather - ONASI; opasi - Susan: 'my parents Nick and Heather, my sister Susan'.

items.sentence: In her free time she loves playing basketball.
items.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida u basketbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ T. 'In my free time, I love playing basketball.'

items.sentence: She hates going to the cinema.
items.whyUz: ⚠ F. 'I also LIKE going to the cinema.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter in Ex. 15 again and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: 15-mashqdagi xatni yana o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TUZILIShI - 4 XATBOShI:

  Para 1 - qiyofa (looks)
  Para 2 - oila (family)
  Para 3 - yoqtirgan narsalar
           (likes)
  Para 4 - xulosa (conclusion)

  Boshlanishi: 'Dear Laura,'
  Yakuni: 'Best wishes, Sally'


⚠ 'A CONCLUSION':

  = xulosa (oxirgi xatboshi).
  'to conclude' = xulosa qilmoq.


⚠ 17-MAShQDA ShU REJA KERAK.

items.prompt: Qaysi xatboshi Salli yoqtirgan narsalar haqida?
items.question: Which paragraph is about what Sally likes?
items.whyUz: Para 3: 'In my free time, I love playing basketball ...'

items.question: Which paragraph is about Sally's family?
items.whyUz: Para 2: 'There are four of us in our family ...'

items.question: Which paragraph is about what Sally looks like?
items.whyUz: Para 1: 'I am tall and slim with green eyes and long straight brown hair.'

items.question: Which paragraph is the conclusion?
items.whyUz: Para 4: 'Well, that's all about me ... Write back soon.'

items.question: How does Sally start/end her letter?
items.answer: She starts with 'Dear Laura,' and ends with 'Best wishes, Sally'.

sections.title: Writing (a letter to a new pen-friend)

exercises.instructionEn: Make notes about yourself under the following headings, then use your notes to write a letter to your new pen-friend. Use the letter in Ex. 15 as a model. Name - City/Country - Age - Appearance - Family Members (Looks/Character) - Like/Love
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida o'zingiz haqingizda qaydlar yozing, so'ng qaydlaringizdan foydalanib yangi qalamkash do'stingizga xat yozing. 15-mashqdagi xatdan namuna sifatida foydalaning. Ism - Shahar/Mamlakat - Yosh - Tashqi qiyofa - Oila a'zolari (qiyofa/xarakter) - Yoqtirgan/sevgan narsalar
exercises.explanationUz:
QALAMKASh DO'STGA XAT - O'ZINGIZ
  HAQINGIZDA (coursebook 15-bet
  Project bilan bir xil).

REJA (15-mashq xati):
  Manzil + sana (o'ng burchak)
  Dear + ism,
  1 Ism, shahar/mamlakat, yosh,
    qiyofa
  2 Oila (a'zolari, kasb, xarakter)
  3 Yoqtirgan narsalar (love/like
    + V-ing, sevimli ...)
  4 Xulosa (that's all about me,
    write back soon)
  Best wishes, + ism


⚠ QAYDLAR → GAPLAR:

  Name: Aziz → 'My name is Aziz'
  City: Tashkent → 'I live in
    Tashkent, Uzbekistan'
  Age: 14 → 'I am fourteen years
    old'
  Appearance: tall, dark hair →
    'I am tall with short dark hair'


⚠ 'A PEN-FRIEND':

  = qalamkash do'st (xat orqali
  do'st). AQSh: 'pen pal'.


⚠ 100 SO'Z ATROFIDA.

modelAnswers:
12 Navoi Street
Tashkent
Uzbekistan

10th May, ...

Dear Laura,

My name is Aziz Karimov and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I am fourteen years old and I am tall and slim with brown eyes and short dark hair.

There are five of us in our family; my parents Bobur and Nilufar, my brother Timur, aged ten, my sister Malika, aged seven, and me. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. They're kind and very friendly. My brother is funny, but he can be a bit noisy sometimes.

In my free time, I love playing football and reading books. My favourite football player is Ronaldo and my favourite writer is Jules Verne. I also like going to the park and visiting my grandparents at weekends.

Well, that's all about me. I hope you like the picture of my family. Write back soon and tell me about yourself.

Best wishes,
Aziz

Mening ismim Aziz Karimov va men Toshkentda, O'zbekistonda yashayman. Men o'n to'rt yoshdaman va baland bo'yli, nozikman, qo'ng'ir ko'zli va kalta qora sochliman.

Oilamizda besh kishimiz: ota-onam Bobur va Nilufar, o'n yoshli ukam Temur, yetti yoshli singlim Malika va men. Otam shifokor, onam o'qituvchi. Ular mehribon va juda samimiy. Ukam qiziqchi, lekin ba'zan biroz shovqinli bo'lishi mumkin.

Bo'sh vaqtimda futbol o'ynash va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman. Sevimli futbolchim - Ronaldo, sevimli yozuvchim - Jyul Vern. Dam olish kunlari bog'ga borish va buvim-bobomnikiga borishni ham yoqtiraman.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Aziz

vocabularyOnPage.en: Nor do I. / Neither do I.

patterns.formula: A: I always/often ... - B: So do I. / I don't.
patterns.exampleEn: I always do my homework. - So do I.
patterns.exampleUz: Men har doim uy vazifamni qilaman. - Men ham.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Tasdiqqa rozilik 'So do I', norozilik 'I don't'.

patterns.formula: A: I never ... - B: Nor do I. / I do.
patterns.exampleEn: I never watch TV. - Nor do I.
patterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon televizor ko'rmayman. - Men ham.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Inkorga rozilik 'Nor do I', norozilik 'I do'.

patterns.formula: There are [son] of us in our family.
patterns.exampleEn: There are four of us in our family.

patterns.formula: X can be a bit [sifat] sometimes.
patterns.exampleEn: My sister can be a bit bossy sometimes.
patterns.exampleUz: Opam ba'zan biroz buyruqboz bo'lishi mumkin.
